title: The Double-Edged Sword: Legumain as a Context-Dependent Mediator and Therapeutic Target in Cancer and Cardiovascular Disease.
snippet: Legumain, an asparaginyl endopeptidase, has emerged as a critical cysteine protease with diverse and complex roles in human health and disease.
